reasons.correctness: Port, adapter, service, rounding, PLN=1, case-insensitive match and exception key all match the interface. The application.yml insert split the cors block: `max-age: 86400` now sits under `currency`, so CORS loses its max-age.
reasons.convention_fit: The port/adapter split, constructor injection and BusinessRuleTranslatableException are correct, and the key is in both messages files. FixedExchangeRateAdapterUnitTest lacks @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class), which the unit-test convention requires.
reasons.design_fit: Cohesive currency/port and currency/adapter packages; the service depends only on ExchangeRatePort. The adapter scans every entry per lookup instead of normalising keys once. The careless yml insertion corrupts unrelated cors config.
reasons.test_quality: Covers rate multiplication, HALF_UP rounding, missing-rate exception key and args, PLN=1, case-insensitivity and unknown code. No Spring context. The null isoCode path is untested.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found existing *Port files, the currency package and the registry port/adapter example before any edit. The edits followed CompanyRegistryPort/GusBir1RegistryAdapter. Config and exception lookups relied on grep.
